an3.54:1.1: atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇaparibbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇaparibbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
an3.54:1.2: sandiṭṭhiko dhammo sandiṭṭhiko dhammoti bho gotama vuccati,
an3.54:1.3: kittāvatā nu kho bho gotama sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
an3.54:2.1: ratto kho brāhmaṇa rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attavyābādhāyapi ceteti, paravyābādhāyapi ceteti, ubhayavyābādhāyapi ceteti. cetasikampi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.54:2.2: rāge pahīṇe nevattavyābādhāyapi ceteti, na paravyābādhāyapi ceteti, na ubhayavyābādhāyapi ceteti, na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.54:3.1: ratto kho brāhmaṇa rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.54:3.2: rāge pahīṇe neva kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, na vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, na manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.54:4.1: ratto kho brāhmaṇa rāgena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attatthampi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, paratthampi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, ubhayatthampi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
an3.54:4.2: rāge pahīne attatthampi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, paratthampi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ubhayatthampi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an3.54:4.3: evampi kho, brāhmaṇa, sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti …pe…
an3.54:5.2: mūḷho kho brāhmaṇa mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attavyābādhāyapi ceteti, paravyābādhāyapi …pe… ubhayavyābādhāyapi ceteti, cetasikampi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.54:5.3: mohe pahīṇe nevattavyābādhāyapi ceteti, na paravyābādhāyapi ceteti, na ubhayavyābādhāyapi ceteti, na cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
an3.54:6.1: mūḷho kho brāhmaṇa mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.54:6.2: mohe pahīṇe neva kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, na vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, na manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
an3.54:7.1: mūḷho kho brāhmaṇa mohena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto attatthampi yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, paratthampi …pe… nappajānāti.
an3.54:7.2: mohe pahīṇe attatthampi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, paratthampi …pe… ubhayatthampi yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
an3.54:7.3: evaṃ kho brāhmaṇa sandiṭṭhiko dhammo hoti akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhīti.
an3.54:8.2: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
